remplacerConfirmer: I understand, replace the project contents
remplacerBloque: The file contains errors: in Replace mode, nothing will be deleted or imported.

motifs.nombreHorsBornes: column “{colonne}”: “{valeur}” is not a whole number between {min} and {max}
motifs.emailDejaPris: an account already uses the address “{email}”: row skipped.
motifs.loginDejaPris: an account already uses the login “{login}”: row skipped.
motifs.effectifInvalide: invalid required headcount “{valeur}”: a whole number, zero or above, is expected.
motifs.competenceDejaPresente: the skill “{nom}” already exists: row skipped.
motifs.jalonDejaPresent: the milestone “{nom}” already exists: row skipped.
motifs.compteDesactive: the account “{email}” is deactivated: no leave can be added to it.
motifs.horsPerimetre: the account “{email}” is outside your scope.
motifs.dateIllisible: unreadable date: “{debut}” → “{fin}”. The expected format is YYYY-MM-DD.
motifs.datesInversees: the end date ({fin}) comes before the start date ({debut}): swap them.
motifs.demiJourneeInconnue: unknown half-day “{valeur}”. Expected values: {attendues}, or leave the column empty.
motifs.demiJourneeSurPlusieursJours: a half-day only applies to a single-day leave: leave the column empty, or bring both dates to the same day.
motifs.soldeInsuffisant: not enough balance for {annee}: {demandes} day(s) requested, {disponibles} available, {manquants} missing.
motifs.typeDesactive: the leave type “{nom}” is deactivated: reactivate it, or choose another type on this row.
motifs.chevauchement: this period overlaps a leave already recorded: row skipped.
motifs.erreurTechnique: the row could not be saved: {detail}
